name: Ask about cataract surgery coverage
goal: User inquires if cataract surgery is covered under employee insurance.
constraints: Bot must route to Group_Mediclaim_Policy, answer only from KB, personalize, and cite correct doc/link. No generic info.

testdata.query: Is cataract surgery covered under our medical insurance?

phases.description: User asks if cataract surgery is covered.
